data.summary: The change meets the acceptance criteria. It adds a pre-paint inline script, a class-based dark mode, a three-state theme toggle next to the PrivacyToggle in both headers, and a bg-slate-900 container for the Home/About links. The theme logic is isolated in a well-tested theme.js with injected storage, root and matchMedia. Only minor polish items remain, and QA reports 53/53 tests passing with no weakened tests.

findings.issue: The late-declared `.dark .hover\:text-gray-700:hover` and `.dark .text-gray-500` overrides have the same specificity as Tailwind's `dark:` utilities and come after them. They win against `dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:text-white` on the ThemeToggle/PrivacyToggle buttons, so the intended hover-to-white is silently lost.
findings.suggestion: Either drop the `dark:` utilities on the buttons that these global overrides already cover, or scope the overrides so they do not collide (for example, use `@layer components` so utilities win).

findings.issue: Formatting inconsistency: `applyTheme('dark',{ root, ...` is missing a space after the comma (also on line 107).
findings.suggestion: Add a space after the comma.

findings.issue: The multi-instance sync via THEME_CHANGE_EVENT/storage and the matchMedia re-read in the component have no automated test, because only the lib helpers are covered. The `var` and `const` usage is also mixed within the component.
findings.suggestion: Consider extracting the subscription logic into a testable helper or adding a component test. Use one declaration style consistently.
findings.rule: PROJECT_AGENTS_MD: use var for local variables

findings.issue: The newline-at-EOF change is formatting churn unrelated to the task.
findings.suggestion: Harmless, but avoid touching unrelated lines.

architectureNotes: The inline head script duplicates the resolveIsDark logic by necessity (must run before first paint); the comment documents the mirroring, which is good.
Global `.dark` CSS overrides for light-only utility classes are a pragmatic retrofit; long term, prefer explicit `dark:` variants in components.
positives: Pure, dependency-injected theme.js with try/catch around storage access.
Defensive matchMedia handler re-reads stored theme so stale listeners cannot override an explicit choice.
Header link class logic deduplicated into isHome/isAbout and shared class constants.
Accessible label on the toggle names the current mode.
Tests assert concrete values and cover the wrap-around and failure paths; helpers are at the end of the file.
